claim_boundary: This confirmation estimates sensitivity to ten exact-feature-group split seeds for the core scratch versus RF-KD comparison. Each split-level value averages two paired optimizer seeds. The repeated holdouts overlap and are therefore reported descriptively, not as independent replications. This does not replace the finalized ten-optimizer-seed result on the fixed primary split and does not cover the full route matrix, deployment, XAI, or Edge-IIoTset.
